name: quant-rigor
description: Rigorous quantitative analysis protocol for trading and investment strategies: 49 formulas with their failure modes, a measurability gate, a backtest checklist, an adversarial contrarian pass, overfitting diagnostics (DSR/PBO/HAC), portfolio risk decomposition, sizing constraints, Monte Carlo nulls (permutation, surrogates, White RC, SPA), charts, and a self-contained HTML report generator. Zero dependencies.
